meta.name: skills-manager
meta.description: Import, normalize, and maintain skills from various sources into the centralized TeamDay skills library. Use when updating the skill library, importing new skills from awesome-agent-skills, or syncing with upstream providers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入并统一维护分散的技能库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责维护团队集中技能库并持续导入新技能
copy.tagline_en: Import and maintain skills from multiple sources in one library.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a central skill library and keep importing new skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把外部技能(如社区、Anthropic、HuggingFace 的)下载、整理进 TeamDay 技能库,统一格式后提交推送,并定期更新子模块和移除过时技能。
howto.when: 当你提出更新技能库、从 awesome-agent-skills 导入新技能,或同步上游来源时,该技能会接管操作。

say.text: 更新 skills/anthropic 子模块到最新版本
把 d3-visualization 技能整理进社区目录
say.note: 它会检查结构、复制文件并提交推送。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps import external skills (e.g., community, Anthropic, HuggingFace) into the TeamDay skills library, normalizes them, commits and pushes updates, and maintains submodules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to update the skill library, import new skills from awesome-agent-skills, or sync with upstream providers.

say_en.text: Import the csv-summarizer skill from awesome-agent-skills
say_en.note: It will fetch, download, and normalize it into the community directory.

say_en.text: Update the skills/anthropic submodule to the latest version
say_en.note: It will run git submodule update --remote and commit/push.

say_en.text: Organize the d3-visualization skill into the community directory
say_en.note: It will check structure, copy files, and commit/push.
